junk_exclusion.map_equivalence: mAP is identical to canonical protocol. Junk queries (person_id=0): dropped from the valid-query denominator by the standard evaluator (num_valid_q is decremented, not averaged as zeros — averaging as zeros would give 2.56 x 11655/11659 = 2.55912%, a 0.00088pp difference). Junk gallery images: removed before true-positive positions are computed under both protocols, so AP over valid items is identical whether exclusion happens at cache time or at eval time.
